Printed edition: Moxon's Mechanick exercises; or, The doctrine of handy-works applied to the art of printing; a literal reprint in two volumes of the first edition published in the year 1683, New York, The Typothetæ of the City of New York, 1896, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/moxonsmechanicke21683moxo. The scan does not show the credit of Theodore Low De Vinne, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
